reported_papers.reason: 专注于移动机器人的实时导航与控制，使用物理信息整流流。属于纯运动规划/控制领域，无视觉语言指令跟随或操作任务，不符合VLA定义。

reported_papers.title: ActiveFly-Bench: Aligning Embodied Question Answering with Vision-Language-Action for Aerial Embodied Perception

reported_papers.reason: 发布首个无人机具身感知基准ActiveFly-Bench，涵盖空中具身问答等任务。作为新数据集/基准具有重要参考价值，但本身非方法创新，归类为值得了解。

reported_papers.title: On the Efficiency of LoRA Fine-Tuning for Vision-Language-Action Models in Industrial Robotic Manipulation
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2607.10172v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deploying billion-parameter Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models on industrial hardware requires fine-tuning to bridge the embodiment gap. reported_papers.title: TAC-LOCO: Unified Whole-Body Control for Quadrupedal TACtile-Informed LOCO-Manipulation
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2607.10132v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dynamic loco-manipulation requires legged robots to coordinate whole-body motion while maintaining stable physical interaction with grasped objects under uncertain external forces. reported_papers.reason: 结合触觉感知实现四足机器人的全身Loco-Manipulation控制。重点在于底层控制律与触觉融合，而非高层VLA策略学习，属于传统机器人控制范畴。

reported_papers.title: Robo-ValueRL: Reliable Value Estimation for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2607.09866v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Offline-to-online reinforcement learning is promising for generalizable robotic manipulation, yet its full-stack complexity obscures reproduction and diagnosis. reported_papers.reason: 关注离线到在线RL中的价值估计可靠性问题，旨在简化复杂系统的复现与诊断。属于RL算法层面的优化，非VLA架构或训练范式的直接创新。

reported_papers.title: More Structure, Not More Capacity: Object-Centric Representations for Visuomotor Imitation Learning
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2607.09825v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Robotic manipulation policies rely on pre-trained vision models that give either a global scene embedding or a dense patch grid. reported_papers.title: TS-Mask VLA: 2D Temporal-Spatial Masking for Vision-Language-Action Model with Effective Bridging
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2607.09818v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models aim to understand natural-language instructions and visual observations, and to generate and execute corresponding actions as embodied agents. reported_papers.title: Maximizing Human Efficiency in Large-Scale Robot Post-Training via VLAC-Cut Guided Pipeline
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2607.09776v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When adapting Vision Language Action (VLA) models to downstream tasks, multiple rounds of post training are required because a single round of data cannot resolve all issues, making continuous iterations necessary to progressively address the weaknesses exposed in previous rounds. reported_papers.reason: 针对VLA下游任务微调，提出VLAC-Cut引导的数据筛选流水线以最大化人工标注效率。该方法能显著减少迭代轮次，是提升VLA工程化部署效率的可复用工具。

reported_papers.title: EgoSteer: A Full-Stack System Towards Steerable Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Videos
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2607.09701v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Steerability is a defining capability of generalist robot policies, yet remains largely absent in dexterous-hand systems for lack of large-scale, language-aligned, and action-accurate demonstration data. reported_papers.title: Reduced-Order Models: The Mother of World Models
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2607.03198v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: World models -- compressed latent representations of an environment that support action-conditioned prediction and planning -- are typically presented as a product of modern self-supervised learning. reported_papers.title: Reward Transport: Property Control in Flow Matching via Noise-Space Alignment
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2607.08781v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The coupling in flow matching -- the rule pairing noise vectors with data points -- is typically treated as a computational choice. reported_papers.title: GATS: Graph-Augmented Tree Search with Layered World Models for Efficient Agent Planning
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2607.08894v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown promise in multi-step planning tasks, but existing approaches like LATS (Language Agent Tree Search) and ReAct rely heavily on LLM inference during planning, leading to high computational costs and stochastic behavior. reported_papers.title: SpikeATac: A Multimodal Tactile Finger with Taxelized Dynamic Sensing for Dexterous Manipulation
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2510.27048v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this work, we introduce SpikeATac, a multimodal tactile finger combining a taxelized and highly sensitive dynamic response (PVDF) with a static transduction method (capacitive) for multimodal touch sensing. reported_papers.title: Causally Debiased Latent Action Model for Embodied Action Conditioned World Models
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2607.09185v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) aim to simulate future observations conditioned on embodied actions, offering a promising foundation for robot planning, policy evaluation, and data augmentation. reported_papers.title: Tactile and Vision Conditioned Contact-Centric Control for Whole-Arm Manipulation
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2607.09218v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Whole-arm manipulation involves direct contact with the environment while the robot completes a task by distributing contact across multiple links as contacts form, slide, and break. reported_papers.title: TactiDex: A Real-World Tactile-Guided Benchmark for Human-Like Dexterous Manipulation
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2607.09190v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tactile feedback is fundamental to Hand-Object Interaction (HOI), governing contact formation, force regulation, and stable manipulation, making it essential for achieving true human-like dexterous manipulation. reported_papers.title: AgenticFocus: Object-Preserving Mixed Reality Synthesis from Human FPV Video for Dexterous Humanoid Learning
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2607.08857v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Human egocentric video is a scalable supervision source for humanoid policy learning, but current pipelines struggle with hand-object occlusion, oversimplified motion, or specialized capture hardware. reported_papers.title: Learning More from Less: Reinforcement Learning from Hindsight
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2607.09042v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used to post-train vision-language-action (VLA) models, but every update consumes robot rollouts that are slow and costly to collect, making sample efficiency a central concern. reported_papers.title: Seeing is Free, Speaking is Not: Uncovering the True Energy Bottleneck in Edge VLM Inference
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2607.09520v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are the perceptual backbone of embodied AI, but their energy footprint on edge hardware remains poorly understood. reported_papers.title: Prompt-Driven Exploration

reported_papers.title: A Formalization of the Mean-Field Derivation of the Vlasov Equation: AI-Assisted Lean Formalization as a Strategy Game

reported_papers.title: Tactile Genesis: Exploring Tactile Sensors at Scale for Learning Dexterous Tasks
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2606.22332v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Tactile sensing is critical for contact-rich dexterous manipulation, yet it remains unclear which tactile abstractions a policy needs and when richer tactile fields justify their hardware cost. reported_papers.title: RoboStream: Weaving Spatio-Temporal Reasoning with Memory in Vision-Language Models for Robotics
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2603.12939v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Enabling reliable long-horizon robotic manipulation is a crucial step toward open-world embodied intelligence. reported_papers.title: Act, Sense, Act: Learning Active Perception from Large-Scale Egocentric Human Data

reported_papers.title: ReinforceGen: Hybrid Skill Policies with Automated Data Generation and Reinforcement Learning

reported_papers.title: Re$^3$Sim: Generating High-Fidelity Simulation Data via 3D-Photorealistic Real-to-Sim for Robotic Manipulation

reported_papers.title: B-spline Policy: Accelerating Manipulation Policies via B-spline Action Representations
reported_papers.abstract_snippet: arXiv:2607.09648v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we present B-spline Policy (BSP), an action representation designed for accelerating robot manipulation policies. reported_papers.title: PAC-ACT: Post-training Actor-Critic for Action Chunking Transformers

reported_papers.title: One-Shot Multimodal Learning from Demonstration with Force-Constrained Elastic Maps

reported_papers.title: PhysV2A: Reachability-Gated and Semantic-Mask-Constrained Feasibility Completion for Video-to-Robot Manipulation

reported_papers.title: CLAP: Direct VLM-to-VLA Adaptation via Language-Action Grounding

reported_papers.title: Mix-QVLA: Task-Evidence-Aware Mixed-Precision Quantization of Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_papers.reason: 提出任务证据感知的混合精度量化框架，在保持VLA性能的同时显著压缩模型体积。为VLA在边缘设备上的高效部署提供了关键的量化技术方案。

reported_papers.title: Lagrange: An Open-Vocabulary, Energy-Based Sparse Framework for Generalized End-to-End Driving
reported_papers.reason: 专注于端到端自动驾驶框架，涉及开放词汇感知与稀疏规划。属于自动驾驶领域，与具身机器人操作（Embodied AI Manipulation）核心场景无关。

reported_papers.title: ENPIRE: Agentic Robot Policy Self-Improvement in the Real World
reported_papers.reason: 实现真实世界中具身智能体的策略自改进，减少人工监督依赖。展示了Agentic VLA在闭环反馈中自我进化的能力，具有重要的工程落地示范意义。

reported_papers.title: DADP: Domain Adaptive Diffusion Policy
reported_papers.reason: 提出域自适应扩散策略以应对未见动力学变化。虽针对泛化性问题，但主要贡献在于RL控制领域的域适应技巧，对VLA整体架构影响有限。

reported_papers.title: Transferring Contact, Not Just Motion: Compliant Grasping Across Dexterous Hands
reported_papers.reason: 强调接触力转移而非单纯运动迁移，实现灵巧手间的合规抓取策略迁移。侧重触觉/力控细节，虽相关但未触及VLA大模型核心架构，且实验规模有限。

reported_papers.title: Bring My Cup! Personalizing Vision-Language-Action Models with Visual Attentive Prompting
reported_papers.reason: 通过视觉注意力提示解决VLA在个性化指令（如“拿我的杯子”）中的实例区分难题。提升了VLA在复杂语义场景下的细粒度理解与执行能力，方法简单有效。

reported_papers.title: Humanoid Everyday: A Comprehensive Robotic Dataset for Open-World Humanoid Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 发布面向人形机器人的开放世界操作数据集，涵盖移动与灵巧操作。重要数据资源，但作为数据集论文，其紧迫性低于算法突破，归为值得了解。

reported_papers.title: ImageWAM: Do World Action Models Really Need Video Generation, or Just Image Editing?
reported_papers.reason: 质疑WAM对视频生成的依赖，提出仅通过图像编辑即可实现高效的世界模型预测。显著降低推理成本，为VLA的世界模型组件提供了轻量级替代方案。

reported_papers.title: 3D-DLP: Self-Supervised 3D Object-Centric Scene Representation Learning
reported_papers.reason: 提出自监督3D对象中心场景表示学习方法，分解RGB-D数据为潜在粒子。虽有助于提升VLA感知模块的表征能力，但属于纯视觉/表示学习范畴，未直接结合动作。

reported_papers.title: MemoryWAM: Efficient World Action Modeling with Persistent Memory
reported_papers.reason: 在World Action Model中引入持久记忆机制，提升对动态环境的长期状态跟踪能力。为VLA处理长视界、部分可观测任务提供了有效的世界模型增强方案。

reported_papers.title: Generating Robot Hands from Human Demonstrations
reported_papers.reason: 探索从人类演示中逆向设计机器人手部结构，涉及形态与控制联合优化。属于机器人本体设计领域，与当前主流VLA软件/算法研究方向差异较大。

reported_papers.title: Slow Brain, Fast Planner: Latency-Resilient VLM-Augmented Urban Navigation
reported_papers.reason: 聚焦城市环境下的移动机器人导航规划，属于自动驾驶/移动底盘范畴，与具身操作（Manipulation）核心场景无实质关联。

reported_papers.title: TaCauchy: An Extensible FEM Framework for Vision-Based Tactile Simulation
reported_papers.reason: 提出基于FEM的视觉触觉仿真框架，解决GPU加速下应力场模拟精度不足的问题。是触觉VLA的重要基础设施，但本身不涉及VLA模型架构或训练范式创新。

reported_papers.title: CoLI: A Reproducible Platform for Continuum Robot Learning via Monolithic 3D Printing and Isomorphic Teleoperation
reported_papers.reason: 介绍一种用于连续体机器人学习的可重复平台及同构遥操作系统。侧重于硬件平台与数据采集流程，虽有价值但非VLA算法或模型层面的核心进展。

reported_papers.title: Co-VLA: Coordination-Aware Structured Action Modeling for Dual-Arm Vision-Language-Action Systems
reported_papers.reason: 针对双臂协作引入结构化动作建模，显式编码协调约束以改善双臂操作的同步性与效率。填补了VLA在复杂双臂协同任务中的建模空白，具有明确的应用价值。

reported_papers.title: Finetuning Vision-Language-Action Models Requires Fewer Layers Than You Think
reported_papers.reason: 发现VLA微调只需更新少数层即可达到全量微调效果，大幅降低计算负担。为资源受限环境下的VLA定制提供了重要的工程洞见和轻量化方案。

reported_papers.title: Frequency-Aware Flow Matching for Continuous and Consistent Robotic Action Generation
reported_papers.reason: 改进流匹配算法以关注频率特性，提升动作生成的连续性和一致性。虽是对Diffusion Policy/Flow Matching的改进，但更多是算法层面的微调，未展示跨平台SOTA突破。

reported_papers.title: Pose6DAug: Physically Plausible Multi-view Object Swapping for Robot Data Augmentation
reported_papers.reason: 提出基于物理合理性的多视角物体交换数据增强方法，解决VLA对未见物体外观/几何分布敏感的问题。直接针对数据稀缺痛点，易于集成到现有训练流程中。

reported_papers.title: MirrorDuo: Reflection-Consistent Visuomotor Learning from Mirrored Demonstration Pairs
reported_papers.reason: 利用镜像对称性从成对演示中学习，有效降低数据采集成本并提升工作空间泛化能力。提供了一种低成本扩充高质量VLA训练数据的可行方案。

reported_papers.title: Tri-Info: Generalizable, Interpretable Failure Prediction for VLA Models via Information Theory
reported_papers.reason: 利用信息论指标构建VLA模型的失败预测器，提供可解释的安全监控机制。有助于在实际部署中识别黑盒模型的潜在风险，是VLA安全落地的关键工具。

reported_papers.title: Co-policy: Responsive Human-Robot Co-Creation for Musical Performances
reported_papers.reason: 聚焦音乐表演场景的人机协作生成，强调创造性而非通用操作能力。属于特定领域的应用研究，方法论对通用VLA泛化性提升的直接参考价值有限。

reported_papers.title: EquiVLA: A General Framework for Rotationally Equivariant Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_papers.reason: 提出旋转等变VLA框架，通过几何归纳偏置解决模型在不同朝向下泛化难的问题。在多个基准上显著优于基线，从架构层面解决了VLA核心的几何泛化瓶颈，具备战略意义。

reported_papers.title: Start Right, Arrive Right: Asynchronous Execution via Initial Noise Selection
reported_papers.reason: 针对流匹配策略的延迟问题，提出通过初始噪声选择实现异步执行，平衡了多步动作生成的连贯性与实时控制需求。为VLA部署提供了具体的工程优化路径。

reported_papers.title: Temporal Self-Imitation Learning
reported_papers.reason: 引入时间自模仿学习机制，防止长视界任务中高效行为在训练过程中被遗忘。虽涉及RL精调，但主要贡献在于训练技巧优化，未提出新的VLA架构或显著超越SOTA。

reported_papers.title: One Demo is Worth a Thousand Trajectories: Action-View Augmentation for Visuomotor Policies
reported_papers.reason: 提出动作-视图增强技术，仅需少量演示即可生成大量多样化训练数据，显著提升视动策略对初始配置和障碍物的泛化能力。该方法即插即用，极具工程实用价值。

reported_papers.title: Playful Agentic Robot Learning
reported_papers.reason: 探索通过“玩耍”让具身智能体自主获取可复用技能，减少对显式指令的依赖。属于Agentic控制的前沿探索，但目前多为概念验证或仿真，缺乏大规模真实机器人部署证据。

reported_papers.title: DiffusionVS: A Generative Framework for Robust Visual Servoing Based on Diffusion Policy
reported_papers.reason: 将扩散策略应用于视觉伺服（Visual Servoing），解决传统回归方法在噪声下的轨迹抖动问题。提供了更鲁棒的闭环控制方案，可直接用于提升现有VLA底层的执行稳定性。

reported_papers.title: WorkBenchMark: A LEGO-Based Assembly Benchmark with an Assembly-by-Disassembly Baseline for the Smart Manufacturing League
reported_papers.reason: 提出基于LEGO Duplo的组装基准WorkBenchMark，旨在评估智能制造中的符号推理与物理操作结合能力。作为新数据集/基准值得关注，但非核心VLA架构创新。

reported_papers.title: Improving Visual Token Reduction via Rectifying Distortions for Efficient Multimodal LLM Inference
reported_papers.reason: 专注于MLLM视觉Token压缩与失真校正，属于纯视觉语言模型优化，无机器人操作场景或具身控制相关实验，不符合VLA核心定义。

reported_papers.title: MolmoMotion: Forecasting Point Trajectories in 3D with Language Instruction
reported_papers.reason: 利用语言指令预测3D点云轨迹，增强对物理交互的预判能力。虽未直接集成VLA，但其运动预测模块可作为VLA感知-规划链路的有益补充。

reported_papers.title: STORM: Slot-based Task-aware Object-centric Representation for robotic Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 提出基于Slot的任务感知对象中心表征，增强视觉特征的结构性与鲁棒性。改善密集特征在操作任务中的表现，可作为VLA感知模块的有效插件。

reported_papers.title: Does VLA Even Know the Basics? Measuring Commonsense and World Knowledge Retention in Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_papers.reason: 系统性评估VLA微调后常识与世界知识的保留情况。揭示知识遗忘现象，为平衡机器人技能学习与通用知识保持提供诊断依据，属重要基准分析。

reported_papers.title: OneCanvas: 3D Scene Understanding via Panoramic Reprojection
reported_papers.reason: 提出全景重投影方法提升VLM的3D场景理解能力，无需复杂几何编码器。虽主要贡献在视觉表征，但其空间推理增强对具身VLA有间接参考价值。

reported_papers.title: Mem-World: Memory-Augmented Action-Conditioned World Models for Persistent Robot Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 引入记忆增强机制改进动作条件世界模型，解决长期操作中的状态持久性问题。提升模型在部分可观测环境下的推理能力，适用于复杂连续任务。

reported_papers.title: Motion-Focused Latent Action Enables Cross-Embodiment VLA Training from Human EgoVideos
reported_papers.reason: 通过运动聚焦的潜在动作表示，实现从人类第一人称视频到跨实体VLA的训练。有效桥接人机形态差异，为利用海量人类视频数据提供可行方案。

reported_papers.title: Zero-Shot Long-Horizon Dexterous Manipulation via Multi-View 3D-Grounded VLM Reasoning
reported_papers.reason: 利用多视图3D-grounded VLM进行零样本长程灵巧操作规划，无需端到端训练。展示了VLM在复杂任务分解中的潜力，适合探索神经符号混合架构的研究者。

reported_papers.title: Do as I Do: Dexterous Manipulation Data from Everyday Human Videos
reported_papers.reason: Pieter Abbeel团队提出从日常人类视频中规模化生成灵巧手操作数据的方法，解决数据瓶颈。在多个灵巧操作基准上显著优于SOTA，为通用具身智能提供关键数据范式。

reported_papers.title: Invertible Neural Network Adapter for One-Step Flow Matching in Robot Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 设计可逆神经网络适配器，实现一步流匹配生成高精度动作。显著提升推理速度并保留多模态条件能力，适合对延迟敏感的实时控制应用。

reported_papers.title: HT-Bench: Benchmarking and Learning Dexterous Full-Hand Tactile Representations with Egocentric Vision
reported_papers.reason: 发布首个全面的手部触觉表征基准及数据集，涵盖多种传感器设计。虽无核心算法突破，但为触觉操作研究提供了必要的标准化评估平台。

reported_papers.title: TactSpace: Learning a Physics-enriched Shared Latent Space for Tactile Sim-to-Real Transfer
reported_papers.reason: 构建富含物理信息的触觉共享潜空间，解决触觉传感器仿真保真度低的问题。填补了触觉VLA领域空白，为触觉Sim2Real迁移提供关键技术支持。

reported_papers.title: Object-Centric Residual RL for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real VLA Enhancement
reported_papers.reason: 结合对象中心表示与残差RL，提升VLA在精确物理交互中的Sim2Real泛化能力。针对模仿学习遗留的执行误差提供修正机制，适用于高精度操作场景。

reported_papers.title: SC3-Eval: Evaluating Robot Foundation Models via Self-Consistent Video Generation
reported_papers.reason: 提出基于自洽视频生成的评估方法，替代昂贵的真实机器人测试。为快速迭代VLA策略提供了可扩展的离线评估工具，显著降低实验成本。

reported_papers.title: Benchmarking Action Spaces in Reinforcement Learning for Vision-based Robotic Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 系统评估不同动作空间（位姿增量、速度等）对RL性能的影响。虽为重要基准分析，但缺乏新算法或架构创新，主要供研究者选择基线时参考。

reported_papers.title: DREAM-Chunk: Reactive Action Chunking with Latent World Model
reported_papers.reason: 引入潜在世界模型实现反应式动作分块，缓解传统开环执行的脆性。该方法提升了长序列操作的鲁棒性，可直接集成到现有VLA推理流程中改善执行稳定性。

reported_papers.title: VEGA: Learning Navigation VLAs from In-the-Wild Egocentric Video with Geometric Trajectory Supervision
reported_papers.reason: 利用无标签野外第一人称视频和几何轨迹监督训练导航VLA，解决了数据稀缺问题。提供了一种低成本扩展导航策略数据的新路径，具有较高复用价值。

reported_papers.title: PAIWorld: A 3D-Consistent World Foundation Model for Robotic Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 构建支持多视角3D一致性的世界基础模型，解决现有WFM在机器人多相机设置下的几何不一致问题。为需要高保真仿真或基于模型的规划提供了新的基础设施。

reported_papers.title: Guava: An Effective and Universal Harness for Embodied Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 提出一种将VLM转化为具身工具使用的框架，作为端到端VLA的替代方案。亮点在于通过工具调用解耦感知与执行，适合希望探索非端到端架构的研究者参考。

reported_papers.title: Unified Motion-Action Modeling for Heterogeneous Robot Learning
reported_papers.reason: 提出统一运动-动作模型（UMA），以3D物体轨迹为接口桥接视觉控制和动力学建模。提供了异构机器人学习的统一视角，具有理论深度。

reported_papers.title: RLRC: Reinforcement Learning-based Recovery for Compressed Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_papers.reason: 针对压缩后的VLA模型，提出基于RL的恢复机制以弥补精度损失。解决了VLA轻量化部署中的性能回退问题，具有工程实用价值。

reported_papers.title: GeneralVLA-2: Geometry-Aware Reconstruction and Governed Memory for Robot Planning
reported_papers.reason: 结合几何感知重建和受控记忆机制，提升VLA的3D理解和规划能力。是对GeneralVLA的显著升级，强调了3D证据在VLA中的作用。

reported_papers.title: WeaveLA: Event Driven Cross-Subtask Latent Memory Weaving for Repetitive Robot Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 通过事件驱动的跨子任务潜在记忆编织，解决重复性操作中上下文依赖问题。针对VLA短视窗缺陷的结构化改进，具有创新性。

reported_papers.title: EBench: Elemental Diagnosis of Generalist Mobile Manipulation Policies
reported_papers.reason: 提出细粒度诊断移动操作策略能力的基准EBench。用于分析模型短板，属于评估工具，非算法改进。

reported_papers.title: WireCraft: A Simulation Benchmark for Industrial DLO Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 发布针对工业柔性线性物体（DLO）操作的仿真基准。填补特定领域Benchmark空白，但非通用VLA方法创新。

reported_papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_papers.reason: 针对基于流匹配的VLA模型提出不确定性量化方法。增强了VLA在安全关键场景下的可靠性评估能力，具有明确的理论贡献和应用价值。

reported_papers.title: LAGO Policy: Latency-Aware Asynchronous Diffusion Policies with Goal-Directed Collision-Free Planning for Smooth Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 提出延迟感知的异步扩散策略，结合目标导向的避障规划以解决运动不平滑问题。针对Diffusion Policy部署痛点的具体工程优化，可立即复用。

reported_papers.title: ThinkingVLA: Interleaved Vision and Language Reasoning for Robotic Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 通过交错视觉和语言推理链（CoT）增强VLA的长程任务处理能力。明确引入了思维链机制，是对现有VLA架构的重要改进。

reported_papers.title: PearlVLA: Progressive Embodied Action-Plan Refinement in Latent Space
reported_papers.reason: 在潜在空间中进行渐进式动作-计划细化，平衡低延迟控制与显式推理。提出了新的VLA推理范式，有助于提升长程任务性能。

reported_papers.title: Qwen-RobotManip Technical Report: Alignment Unlocks Scale for Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models
reported_papers.reason: 探讨将大语言模型的对齐与缩放策略应用于机器人操作。提供了关于数据对齐和规模化训练的实证洞见，对构建大规模VLA有参考意义。

reported_papers.title: ERQA-Plus: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Reasoning in Embodied AI
reported_papers.reason: 发布用于诊断具身智能推理能力的基准测试ERQA-Plus。作为评估工具很有价值，但属于Benchmark类，非方法创新。

reported_papers.title: MuseVLA: An Adaptive Multimodal Sensing Vision-Language-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 引入触觉等多模态感知到VLA模型，解决仅靠RGB无法感知物理属性的问题。填补了触觉VLA方向的空白，具有明确的实验验证和应用价值。

reported_papers.title: GASE: Gaussian Splatting-Based Automated System for Reconstructing Embodied-Simulation Environments
reported_papers.reason: 基于3D Gaussian Splatting自动化重建仿真环境。属于场景重建技术，为机器人提供仿真场地，非VLA模型本身的方法论创新。

reported_papers.title: MagicSim: A Unified Infrastructure for Executable Embodied Interaction
reported_papers.reason: 提出连接控制、技能和规划的统一仿真基础设施。属于工程平台类工作，重要但不紧急，缺乏具体的VLA算法创新。

reported_papers.title: When Robots Sleep: Offline Skill Consolidation for Shared-Policy Robot Learning
reported_papers.reason: 研究连续技能学习中的离线巩固机制，防止灾难性遗忘。侧重于RL策略更新机制，虽与VLA相关，但更偏向传统RL而非多模态VLA核心架构。

reported_papers.title: AnnotateAnything: Automatic Annotation of 3D Assets for Robot Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 提出自动标注3D资产语义和物理属性的工具，服务于仿真数据生成。属于基础设施类工作，对VLA训练有间接帮助，但非直接相关。

reported_papers.title: DexLink Hand: A Compact, Affordable, 16-DOF Linkage-Driven Hand with Human-Like Dexterity

reported_papers.title: MSACT: Multistage Spatial Alignment for Stable Low-Latency Fine Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 针对双臂精细操作提出多级空间对齐方法以降低延迟并稳定定位。主要贡献在于控制层面的几何对齐，非VLA核心范式创新，且依赖特定硬件配置，通用性受限。

reported_papers.title: Stereo Multistage Spatial Attention for Real-Time Mobile Manipulation Under Visual Scale Variation and Disturbances
reported_papers.reason: 提出立体多级空间注意力机制以应对移动操作中的尺度变化与干扰。侧重传统视觉感知模块优化，未深度融合VLA架构，且缺乏大规模基准对比，属相邻领域改进。

reported_papers.title: Learning while Deploying: Fleet-Scale Reinforcement Learning for Generalist Robot Policies
reported_papers.reason: 探索通用机器人策略的大规模在线强化学习部署框架，解决离线预训练后的分布漂移与长尾失效问题。提供 fleet-scale RL 的工程洞见，对生产环境VLA迭代具直接参考意义。

reported_papers.title: MiniVLA-Nav v1: A Multi-Scene Simulation Dataset for Language-Conditioned Robot Navigation
reported_papers.reason: 发布面向语言条件物体接近导航的仿真数据集MiniVLA-Nav v1，支持NVIDIA Nova Carter机器人。虽填补移动操作数据空白，但仅限仿真验证，暂缺真实世界迁移证据。

reported_papers.title: Embodied Interpretability: Linking Causal Understanding to Generalization in Vision-Language-Action Models
reported_papers.reason: 将视觉-动作归因建模为干预估计过程，揭示VLA分布偏移下的虚假相关性根源。提供可解释性分析工具，帮助调试VLA失败案例并指导因果特征对齐，具有明确诊断价值。

reported_papers.title: Lucid-XR: An Extended-Reality Data Engine for Robotic Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 推出基于XR头显的生成式数据引擎Lucid-XR，利用vuer仿真环境实时生成多模态训练数据。为VLA研究者提供低成本、高多样性的数据采集与合成方案，本周即可尝试部署。

reported_papers.title: E$^2$DT: Efficient and Effective Decision Transformer with Experience-Aware Sampling for Robotic Manipulation
reported_papers.reason: 针对决策Transformer提出经验感知采样方法以改善长程任务性能。虽涉及操作控制，但属于对现有BC/DT框架的工程优化，缺乏架构级创新或显著SOTA突破。

reported_papers.title: World Model for Robot Learning: A Comprehensive Survey
reported_papers.reason: 全面综述世界模型在机器人学习中的应用，涵盖策略学习、规划及数据生成等方向。作为领域背景知识补充，适合快速了解现状但无即时工程复用价值。

reported_papers.title: Being-H0.7: A Latent World-Action Model from Egocentric Videos
reported_papers.reason: 提出基于第一人称视频的潜在世界-动作模型，旨在解决稀疏动作监督导致的捷径学习问题。通过引入世界模型约束增强VLA的表征能力，为提升泛化性提供新视角。
